body: The first-aid kit and water bottle share sticky pollen from the seed trial. They were bundled after the bottle's inside turned slimy with the same pollen.
title: First-aid kit and water bottle, monday morning

body: A pencil and map share the same pocket. One route is marked toward the road, then overwritten with a firm line back toward the building, and the second line has been traced twice as if copied from an instruction.
title: An exit marked twice
